units.text: INT. BARBARA - CONTINUOUS
No: he only provided the wine. I think it was Dionysos who made me drunk.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: To Barbara.
I told you I was possessed.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: You're not sober yet. Go home to bed at once.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: I have never before ventured to reproach you, Lady Brit; but how could you marry the Prince of Darkness?
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: It was much more excusable to marry him than to get drunk with him. That is a new accomplishment of Andrew's, by the way. He usen't to drink.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: He doesn't now. He only sat there and completed the wreck of my moral basis, the rout of my convictions, the purchase of my soul. He cares for you, Barbara. That is what makes him so dangerous to me.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: That has nothing to do with it, Dolly. There are larger loves and diviner dreams than the fireside ones. You know that, don't you?
units.name: BARBARA

units.text: Yes: that is our understanding. I know it. I hold to it. Unless he can win me on that holier ground he may amuse me for a while; but he can get no deeper hold, strong as he is.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Keep to that; and the end will be right. Now tell me what happened at the meeting?
units.name: BARBARA

units.text: It was an amazing meeting. Mrs Baines almost died of emotion. Jenny Hill went stark mad with hysteria. The Prince of Darkness played his trombone like a madman: its brazen roarings were like the laughter of the damned. 117 conversions took place then and there. They prayed with the most touching sincerity and gratitude for Bodger, and for the anonymous donor of the 5000 pounds. Your father would not let his name be given.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: That was rather fine of the old man, you know. Most chaps would have wanted the advertisement.
units.name: LOMAX

units.text: He said all the charitable institutions would be down on him like kites on a battle field if he gave his name.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: That's Andrew all over. He never does a proper thing without giving an improper reason for it.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: He convinced me that I have all my life been doing improper things for proper reasons.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Adolphus: now that Barbara has left the Salvation Army, you had better leave it too. I will not have you playing that drum in the streets.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Your orders are already obeyed, Lady Brit.
units.name: CUSINS

units.text: Dolly: were you ever really in earnest about it? Would you have joined if you had never seen me?
units.name: BARBARA

units.text: CUSINS [disingenuously] Well--er--well, possibly, as a collector of religions--
LOMAX [cunningly] Not as a drummer, though, you know.
You are a very clearheaded brainy chap, Cholly; and it must have been apparent to you that there is a certain amount of tosh about--
Charles: if you must drivel, drivel like a grown-up man and not like a schoolboy.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: LOMAX [out of countenance] Well, drivel is drivel, don't you know, whatever a man's age.

In good society in England, Charles, men drivel at all ages by repeating silly formulas with an air of wisdom. Schoolboys make their own formulas out of slang, like you. When they reach your age, and get political private secretaryships and things of that sort, they drop slang and get their formulas out of The Spectator or The Times. You had better confine yourself to The Times. You will find that there is a certain amount of tosh about The Times; but at least its language is reputable.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: LOMAX [overwhelmed] You are so awfully strong-minded, Lady Brit--
Rubbish!
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Morrison comes in.
What is it?
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: If you please, my lady, Mr Undershaft has just drove up to the door.
units.name: MORRISON

units.text: Well, let him in.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Morrison hesitates.
What's the matter with you?
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Shall I announce him, my lady; or is he at home here, so to speak, my lady?
units.name: MORRISON

units.text: Announce him.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Thank you, my lady. You won't mind my asking, I hope. The occasion is in a manner of speaking new to me.
units.name: MORRISON

units.text: Quite right. Go and let him in.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Thank you, my lady.
units.name: MORRISON

units.text: He withdraws.
Children: go and get ready.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Sarah and Barbara go upstairs for their out-of-door wrap.
Charles: go and tell Stephen to come down here in five minutes: you will find him in the drawing room.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Charles goes.
Adolphus: tell them to send round the carriage in about fifteen minutes.
units.name: LADY BRITOMART

units.text: Adolphus goes.
MORRISON [at the door] Mr Undershaft.
Undershaft comes in.
Morrison goes out.
